body:
WHAT
While a response streams, Session.streamAssistantTurn now emits `tool_call_streaming` { id, tool, argChars, at } when a tool call's name arrives (tool_use_start), and again at most about once a second per call while its arguments stream, with the characters received so far. The live output counter (context_update) counts the tool-call arguments too and is refreshed while they stream. Each call's writing time — from its tool_use_start to the next call's start or the end of the stream — rides on its tool_call_started as the optional `writingMs`. emitFromChild keeps a subagent's tool_call_streaming out of the top-level stream (its rows still appear at tool_call_started, tagged, as before).
Desktop: tool_call_streaming draws the call's row at once in the work group, marked as being written ("writing · 3.2k chars") with a live timer, and finishes the reasoning block above it; when the next call starts being written the previous row's writing time freezes. tool_call_started for the same id turns that row into the call — no second row — and the row's time is then writingMs plus the run, with a tooltip splitting the two. A row whose call never started (the stream dropped, the turn was stopped, a hook blocked it) stops running at turn end and says it was not run. TUI: the activity line reads "writing" with the tool's name.

WHY
Field run 2026-09-24/25: gaps of up to 22 minutes with nothing on screen and a frozen token counter while the model wrote tool calls, after which each tool ran in milliseconds and its row read "0s". Together with the lost reasoning (reasoning-goes-back-to-the-model) this is the owner's main complaint: all the time appears to go into reasoning and every step after it takes no time.

WHERE
engine/protocol/src/types.ts — the tool_call_streaming frame, tool_call_started.writingMs. engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — streamAssistantTurn(), PendingToolCall, executeToolCalls() (announce, refuse), emitFromChild(). app/renderer/modules/landing.js — handleEngineEvent, onToolCallStreaming, onToolCallStarted, onTurnFinished. app/renderer/modules/stream.js — createToolRow, the writing state, finishToolRow. tui/src/protocol.ts, tui/src/engine/useEngine.ts — the activity line.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (fs) One response with two tool calls: for each id, tool_call_streaming comes before tool_call_started; the first call's streaming frame comes before the second's; every tool_call_started carries a numeric writingMs.
2. (fs) While a long Write's arguments stream, a context_update whose outputTokens counts them arrives before that call's tool_call_started.
3. (fs) A subagent's tool call being written sends no tool_call_streaming to the top-level stream, while its tagged tool_call_started still arrives.
4. (net) Through the real Engine on a real OpenAICompatProvider, an endpoint that streams one call's arguments over at least 600 ms gives that call a writingMs of at least 500, and a tool_call_streaming before its tool_call_started.
5. (ui) A tool_call_streaming frame draws one running row reading "writing"; tool_call_started for the same id turns it into the call without a second row; after tool_call_finished the row's time is the writing plus the run (2 min writing + 10 s run reads 2m10s).
6. (ui) A row whose call never started stops running when the turn ends and says it was not run.
7. (ui) A later reply's call under an id an earlier reply already used (local servers that number every reply from call_0) gets a row of its own, and its start turns that new row into the call.
